purpose: Metadata-only same-building acquisition-context comparison; no fitting/prediction or geometric probe
acquisition_definition: USERID, PHONEID, UTC date; acquisition IDs use global sorted identities from the UJI loader
fraction_definition: Equal task weight; within task, fraction of distinct Q acquisition IDs or phones present in H; all/any and disjoint are task fractions

old_B1.protocol: old54; B1 subset 24 events; A/B acquisition directions

performance_context.boundary: Different task draws, weighting/implementation may differ; descriptive side-by-side only, no pooled scores or causal attribution.

limitations: Acquisition overlap describes shared user/phone/day labels, not duplicate scans or shared target labels.
Overlap alone does not establish why WKNN performance differs; same-building comparisons still use different S/Q selections and weighting.
B2 new protocol has metadata only; no new B2 performance was generated.
